name: Seeed XIAO nRF52840
description: Thumb-sized nRF52840 board (21 x 17.5 mm, USB-C, Bluetooth LE) at 3.3 V logic with a built-in LiPo charger (BQ25101) on the BAT pads underneath, programmed with Seeed's nRF52 Arduino core (Adafruit-based). Runs real firmware in Renode (local Docker) with Nordic's SoftDevice booted like on the board; Bluetooth is not emulated. Pin ids are D0-D10. Serial is USB on the real board: the simulator build prints it on Serial1 (TX D6). Wire = D4 / D5, SPI = D10 / D9 / D8, RGB LED (active low). A LiPo on BAT+ / BAT- charges from USB and runs the board without it. 3.3 V logic only.

pins.label: D0/A0
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.02; McuBackend pin "D0". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN0 (analogRead).

pins.label: D1/A1
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.03; McuBackend pin "D1". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN1 (analogRead).

pins.label: D2/A2
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.28; McuBackend pin "D2". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN4 (analogRead).

pins.label: D3/A3
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.29; McuBackend pin "D3". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN5 (analogRead).

pins.label: D4/SDA
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.04; McuBackend pin "D4". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN2 (analogRead). Wire SDA (TWIM0).

pins.label: D5/SCL
pins.description: nRF52840 P0.05; McuBackend pin "D5". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). AIN3 (analogRead). Wire SCL (TWIM0).

pins.label: D6/TX
pins.description: nRF52840 P1.11; McuBackend pin "D6". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). Serial1 TX (UARTE0); the simulator build also prints Serial here.

pins.label: 5V
pins.description: 5V: USB VBUS (power.usb, default plugged) or a 5 V supply in. Charges a LiPo on the BAT pads (BQ25101) and feeds the 3.3 V LDO.

pins.label: GND
pins.description: Ground (all GND pins are one node).

pins.label: 3V3
pins.description: 3.3 V out of the on-board LDO (Faber checks against 200 mA).

pins.label: D10/MOSI
pins.description: nRF52840 P1.15; McuBackend pin "D10". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). SPI MOSI.

pins.label: D9/MISO
pins.description: nRF52840 P1.14; McuBackend pin "D9". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). SPI MISO.

pins.label: D8/SCK
pins.description: nRF52840 P1.13; McuBackend pin "D8". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). SPI SCK (SPIM2).

pins.label: D7/RX
pins.description: nRF52840 P1.12; McuBackend pin "D7". 3.3 V logic, NOT 5 V tolerant. Any pin does PWM (analogWrite). Serial1 RX; also the usual SPI chip select.

pins.label: BAT+
pins.description: BAT+ pad on the underside: a 3.7 V LiPo's + lead. The BQ25101 charges it from USB (50 mA, or 100 mA with P0.13 LOW) and it powers the board when USB is unplugged. Read it with analogRead(PIN_VBAT) after digitalWrite(VBAT_ENABLE, LOW): P0.31 sees VBAT x 510k / 1510k.

pins.label: BAT-
pins.description: BAT- pad on the underside: the LiPo's - lead (ground).

footprint: 21 x 17.5 mm castellated module, 2 x 7 pins at 0.1 in, rows 0.6 in apart, BAT pads underneath

bindings.description: Board has power: USB plugged (power.usb) or a supply on its power pins keeps 3.3 V up; the firmware is held in reset while false.
True when this board runs the project's firmware (has an MCU backend).
RGB LED red (P0.26, lit when LOW; LED_BUILTIN) 0..1.
RGB LED green (P0.30, lit when LOW) 0..1.
RGB LED blue (P0.06, lit when LOW) 0..1.
Charge LED: 1 while the BQ25101 charges the battery.
Battery label: 'no battery', 'charging 48 mA', 'full', 'on battery 3.81 V'.
Digital level 0/1 of each GPIO, e.g. pin_D0 (only on the firmware board).

features.description: user RGB LED; set expose true for a light pipe

availability.reason: Its fixture test passed on 2026-11-11 (packages/sim-backends/src/renode/boards.integration.test.ts: real firmware boots; every listed pin works as an output and as an input; Wire, SPI, analogRead, analogWrite, attachInterrupt and Serial reach Faber's parts). Run with Renode 1.17.0's native build; the faber/renode Docker image (same Renode version) could not be re-run that day because Docker Desktop was failing on the test machine.
